create_tensorboard_writer: create a TensorBoardWriter instance with a log directory and optional prefix for metric names
write_metrics_to_tensorboard: write a dictionary of metrics data to tensorboard using the write method with a step field
flush_tensorboard_writer: flush the tensorboard writer buffer to ensure all metrics are written to disk
close_tensorboard_writer: close the tensorboard writer to release the underlying file writer resources
log_scalar_and_text_metrics: log scalar numbers and text strings as tensorboard metrics with automatic array and tensor conversion
